sources.source_name: Georgia DOR — Owner Harvest Timber Values
sources.description: Annual weighted-average price PAID for standing timber ($/ton) in all 159 Georgia counties, computed by the Revenue Commissioner from the PT-283T sale/harvest reports every private Georgia timber sale must file (PUBLIC; refreshes annually). A near-census of PRIVATE transactions rather than a sampled survey, which is why ownership_basis is private_transaction_filing and not private_survey or tax_assessed — the values are used for ad valorem assessment but derived from prices actually paid. Native $/ton (identity conversion): the only Southeastern public source with no log-rule decision. Nine products: softwood pulpwood/chip-n-saw/sawtimber/poles/posts/fuelchips + hardwood pulpwood/sawtimber/firewood. ⚠ THE COUNTY GRAIN IS NOMINAL — DOR replicates a handful of price vectors across all 159 counties (49 distinct zones in 2020, just 2 by 2026), so counties within a zone are not independent and the state_avg is a simple county-count mean, not volume-weighted. ⚠ 2022 IS MISSING: DOR keeps only the current + prior year and the Wayback Machine never captured that edition.
Quarterly volume-weighted stumpage bid prices from advertised Michigan State-Forest timber sales (PUBLIC; refreshes over time).

sources.source_name: Montana BBER — Quarterly Delivered Log Prices
sources.description: Recent-average mill-DELIVERED log prices ($/MBF, Scribner Decimal rule) from the University of Montana Bureau of Business & Economic Research quarterly survey of primary wood processors (PUBLIC; refreshes over time). Three feeds: Montana statewide (2000q1->present; the 2000-2022 layouts also break out Eastern/Western Montana sub_state rows) + USFS Region 2 (Rocky Mtn: MT/WY/SD/NE) + Region 4 (Intermountain: MT/ID/WY/UT), both multi_state_avg rolling windows. DELIVERED (a private-mill transaction survey), so market_type=delivered / price_basis=observed_delivered and ownership_basis=private_survey -- source_type=public and ownership_basis=private_survey are orthogonal. ⚠ No per-species volume is published, so prices are a SIMPLE MEAN (not volume-weighted). MT appears in all three feeds and WY in R2+R4 -- filter to ONE region_type to avoid double-counting.
sources.geographic_coverage: MT (+ WY, SD, NE, ID, UT via USFS R2/R4)

sources.source_name: Montana DNRC Trust-Land Timber Sale Bid Results
sources.description: Realized winning-bid (Rank 1) SAWLOG STUMPAGE in $/ton from competitive auctions of Montana state trust-land + Good Neighbor timber (PUBLIC; refreshes over time). Volume-weighted (by est. tons) to the DNRC land office (region_type=land_office) + a Montana state_avg rollup. $/ton native (identity conversion; the PDFs also print a per-sale Scribner tons->MBF factor). Non-sawtimber columns (Firewood/Biomass/Pulp/Other) are dropped; Ponderosa is kept as its own species (ponderosa_pine, routinely bid at a nominal ~$2/ton floor) so it never dilutes the main sawlog price (combined_softwood). Quarter is NULL for sales whose PDF left the bid-opening date blank (year from the filename). History deeper than FY2023 is available by email request only (deferred).

sources.source_name: Oregon ODF State-Forest Timber Sale Results
sources.description: Realized winning-bid STUMPAGE prices ($/MBF, Scribner) from competitive auctions of Oregon state-forest timber (PUBLIC; refreshes over time). By ODF district (region_type=district) + an Oregon state_avg rollup. Bidder Rank 1 = the realized price; ranks 2+ (losing bids) are dropped. No per-species volume is published, so prices are a SIMPLE (sale-count) MEAN of winning bids, not volume-weighted -- a documented limitation. A refreshing ~3-year rolling window (current = 2023Q3-2026Q2); deeper history is PDF/prospectus-only (deferred).

sources.source_name: USFS PNW Research Station — NW Forest Industries (PPET)
sources.description: Annual average STUMPAGE prices ($/MBF, Scribner) from the PNW series "Production, Prices, Employment & Trade in NW Forest Industries, 1958-2023" (PUBLIC; historical/backfill, data end 2022). National-Forest sawtimber by species x USFS Region (R1/R4/R5/R6/R10) + public-lands stumpage by state x agency (USFS/BLM/BIA/State). ownership_basis here is the predominant (federal NF) basis; the precise per-row basis lives on the fact.
sources.geographic_coverage: MT, ID, WA, OR, CA, AK

sources.source_name: Texas A&M Forest Service — Timber Price Trends
sources.description: Annual VOLUME-WEIGHTED average stumpage prices ($/ton) from an independent survey of up to 60 cooperators active in the East Texas timber market (PUBLIC; refreshes annually, bimonthly issues also published). U.S. FOREST SERVICE SALES ARE EXCLUDED, so these are private/non-federal market prices — ownership_basis=private_survey, the same basis as the licensed TMS but from a wholly separate cooperator panel, which makes it a genuine cross-check rather than a restatement. Pine sawtimber/pulpwood/chip-n-saw + hardwood mixed sawtimber/pulpwood, by Northeast and Southeast Texas (region_type=sub_state) plus the survey's own East Texas statewide rollup. Native $/ton (identity conversion): the report's $/MBF and $/Cord columns are the $/ton figure times a flat factor (8.0 t/MBF pine sawtimber on the DOYLE scale, 2.7 t/cord pulpwood) and are deliberately NOT ingested — they add no information and would substitute TFS factors for GTR-SRS-251's. ⚠ 2005 has no hardwood sawtimber: that edition reported a veneer-inclusive "Sawlogs & Veneer" basket rather than the "Mixed Sawlogs" used from 2006 on. ⚠ 1999-2004 annual summaries are scanned images with no extractable text.

Realized National-Forest SAWTIMBER stumpage prices, derived value/volume (Sold) from the USFS quarterly Cut-and-Sold report (PUBLIC), all 9 USFS regions (R1-R6, R8-R10). $/MBF in the region's standard log rule: Scribner in the West, International 1/4 in the South (R8) & North (R9) per GTR-SRS-251 Table 1. Complements PNW (West) and the licensed private-survey TMS (R8/South) + TMN (R9/Lake States+NE). Two series: ANNUAL fiscal years FY1977-2023 parsed from the PDF archive, at national_forest grain + a usfs_region rollup; and QUARTERLY from FY2026 Q1, at usfs_region grain, differenced from reports that are cumulative within each fiscal year (XLSX where posted, otherwise the CUTS203F PDF). ⚠ Since FY19 Q3, Good Neighbor sale volumes are included but their values are not, biasing derived unit values low; value=0 rows are dropped.
sources.geographic_coverage: National Forests in the West (R1-R6,R10), South (R8: 13 SE states), and North (R9: Lake States + Northeast)
